meta.note: Single source of truth. Every value traces to a v1.4 section. CSS and the Office theme are generated FROM this file — never hand-edited. If a value is needed that v1.4 does not define, that is a gap: log it, do not invent a token.

blue.role: Primary ground. Covers, dividers, statements, links.

ink.role: Night ground and primary text colour.

white.role: Reading ground — reports and print; panels on chalk.

charcoal.role: Secondary copy, captions, slide titles on light.

accents.comment: Surface palette only. COL-06 (Fixed): never encode data in these.

pink.role: Hot counter-signal, accent bars, left rules

teal.role: Cool highlight, section headers on dark

chartRamp.comment: Data only. Four series maximum (DAT-04, Fixed). Direct labelling is the compliance mechanism (COL-12, Fixed) — decide labelling before colour (COL-11).
chartRamp.warning: Book ch04 measured: under protanopia series 1 and 2 render at 1.10:1 and the lightness order inverts. Do not claim this ramp survives all CVD.

neutralsRemoved.note: REMOVED 16 Aug 2026. #D8D8D8 #A6A6A6 #6E6E6E #4A4A4A were read out of v1.4 §12 where they render the GREYSCALE DEMONSTRATION of the chart ramp — the desaturated strip proving lightness climbs monotonically. They are a rendering artefact, not tokens. Promoting them into the palette invented four greys nobody approved.

colour.greysPolicy: There are no greys. Ink #0D0D0D, charcoal #2D2D2D, chalk #F3F3F3 and white #FFFFFF cover every neutral need. Anything between them is an invention.

display.use: Covers, section dividers, the big statement.

h1.use: Break to two lines rather than shrinking.

h2.use: Tracking compensates for optical tightening as caps shrink.

h3.use: The floor. Caps stop working below 16pt.

document.scale: UNDECIDED — see gaps. Two candidates on the foundations sheet, 2026-08-16.

capsFloor.note: Resolves the v1.4 §08 internal conflict (labels stated at 14pt minimum, H3 note states caps stop working below 16pt) in favour of 16. Adaptable.

slide.status: UNDER REVIEW — grid geometry is an open decision. v1.4 as written recorded here.

separator.colour: blue on light, teal on dark

accentBar.use: Above a pull quote only. The one decorative use.

scale.note: One base unit, .25em, everything a multiple. Short (9 steps) and non-linear — increments widen as values grow, because perceived difference is proportional. em so it scales with context, like every component. ch02, Fixed.

slideScale.note: Measured from the hand-built decks and recorded in joy.css, where it was defined and never used. Percentages of slide width.

direction.position: Minimalist. Bright colours as set out. Plenty of breathing space to let the message carry.
direction.principle: The joy comes from what we are up to, not from ornament. The decision layer keeps the message in check.
